name: Transaction Pro
description: Bulk import of invoices, journal entries, bills, and bank statements from a spreadsheet into QuickBooks Desktop and Online, plus export and bulk delete. Sarasota. Around since 2002. transactionpro.com now points at Rightworks, the QuickBooks hosting company, which owns it.

mentions.evidence: Owler estimates about $5 million a year, with fewer than 10 employees. Treat that loosely. The company has not published revenue. Capterra lists $199 a year for the importer, $299 a year for Pro, and flat monthly plans at $99, $299, and $499. Those prices are the menu, not the estimate.
mentions.indieAngle: A spreadsheet importer for an accounting file is a twenty-year business.

whyItPrints: A bookkeeper onboarding a client, or cleaning a file, buys it every year.
whyThisMatters: A bookkeeper onboarding a client, or cleaning a file, wants a pile of invoices to go in at once.
